+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 20: batch 50 - dọn nốt cụm phần mềm HTKK/khai thuế trong Mẫu file kê khai."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase20-batch50.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase20-batch50.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase20_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    src_rows = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "bieu-mau"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "mau-file-ke-khai"
+    ]
+    pat_htkk = re.compile(r"phần mềm\s*(hỗ\s*trợ\s*kê\s*khai\s*thuế\s*)?htkk", re.IGNORECASE)
+    htkk_rows = [a for a in sorted(src_rows, key=lambda x: x["href"]) if pat_htkk.search(a.get("title") or "")]
+
+    selected = list(htkk_rows)  # hiện còn 48
+    extra_hrefs = [
+        "thu-vien/phan-mem-dang-ky-ma-so-thue-ca-nhan-moi-nhat.html",
+        "thu-vien/phan-mem-ho-tro-ke-khai-thue-3-4-3-moi-nhat.html",
+    ]
+    href_map = {a["href"]: a for a in src_rows}
+    for href in extra_hrefs:
+        if href in href_map and href_map[href] not in selected:
+            selected.append(href_map[href])
+
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for a in selected:
+        decisions[a["href"]] = {
+            "kind": "cong-cu",
+            "lv1": "phan-mem-cong-cu",
+            "lv2": "htkk-etax-thue-dien-tu",
+            "lv3": "htkk-guide-import-bang-ke",
+            "reason": "phase20-htkk-releases-to-cong-cu",
+        }
+    if len(decisions) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase20 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện chỉ chọn được {len(decisions)}")
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 21: batch 50 - dọn nốt Mẫu file kê khai + bổ sung 3 bài tool rõ ràng."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase21-batch50.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase21-batch50.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase21_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    src_rows = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "bieu-mau"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "mau-file-ke-khai"
+    ]
+    selected = sorted(src_rows, key=lambda x: x["href"])  # currently 47 rows
+
+    # Top-up 3 rows tool-like ngoài cụm để đủ 50
+    extra_hrefs = [
+        "thu-vien/mau-bang-ke-ban-le-hang-hoa-dich-vu-co-duoi-200-000-dong-theo-tt-39.html",
+        "thu-vien/mau-phieu-xuat-kho-theo-thong-tu-99.html",
+        "thu-vien/cac-ham-thuong-dung-trong-ke-toan-excel-de-len-so-sach.html",
+    ]
+    href_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    for href in extra_hrefs:
+        row = href_map.get(href)
+        if row and row not in selected:
+            selected.append(row)
+
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for a in selected:
+        href = a["href"]
+        title = a.get("title") or ""
+        lv2_key = a.get("topicLv2Key") or ""
+        lv3_key = a.get("topicLv3Key") or ""
+
+        if "htkk" in title.lower() or lv2_key == "htkk-etax-thue-dien-tu":
+            tgt_lv2 = "htkk-etax-thue-dien-tu"
+            tgt_lv3 = "htkk-guide-import-bang-ke"
+        else:
+            tgt_lv2 = "excel-va-cong-cu-khac"
+            if lv3_key.startswith("excel-") or lv3_key == "cong-cu-ho-tro-ke-khai-cu":
+                tgt_lv3 = lv3_key
+            else:
+                tgt_lv3 = "excel-cong-cu-khac"
+
+        decisions[href] = {
+            "kind": "cong-cu",
+            "lv1": "phan-mem-cong-cu",
+            "lv2": tgt_lv2,
+            "lv3": tgt_lv3,
+            "reason": "phase21-mau-file-ke-khai-to-cong-cu",
+        }
+
+    if len(decisions) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase21 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện chỉ chọn được {len(decisions)}")
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if (
+            kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS
+            or lv1 not in lv1_labels
+            or lv2 not in lv2_labels
+            or lv3 not in lv3_labels
+        ):
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase21Batch50"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase21-batch50",
+        "plannedCount": len(decisions),
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {"countsAfterRebuild": counts},
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 21 - Batch 50",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Planned: **{len(decisions)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "planned": len(decisions),
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "report": str(OUT_MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 22: batch 50 - chuyển 50 bài software guide từ Hướng dẫn sang Công cụ."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase22-batch50.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase22-batch50.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase22_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    src_rows = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "huong-dan"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "phan-mem-cong-cu"
+    ]
+    selected = sorted(src_rows, key=lambda x: x["href"])[:50]
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for a in selected:
+        decisions[a["href"]] = {
+            "kind": "cong-cu",
+            "lv1": "phan-mem-cong-cu",
+            "lv2": a.get("topicLv2Key") or "excel-va-cong-cu-khac",
+            "lv3": a.get("topicLv3Key") or "excel-cong-cu-khac",
+            "reason": "phase22-software-guides-to-cong-cu",
+        }
+    if len(decisions) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase22 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện chỉ chọn được {len(decisions)}")
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if (
+            kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS
+            or lv1 not in lv1_labels
+            or lv2 not in lv2_labels
+            or lv3 not in lv3_labels
+        ):
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase22Batch50"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase22-batch50",
+        "plannedCount": len(decisions),
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {"countsAfterRebuild": counts},
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 22 - Batch 50",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Planned: **{len(decisions)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]

+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:

+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):

+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):

+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",

+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 26: batch 50 - chuẩn hóa nốt lv3 biểu mẫu kế toán + 2 công văn thuế."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase26-batch50.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase26-batch50.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+TOPUP_MOVES: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {
+    "thu-vien/cac-khoan-phu-cap-tro-cap-de-xac-dinh-thu-nhap-chiu-thue-tncn.html": {
+        "kind": "van-ban",
+        "lv1": "thue",
+        "lv2": "cong-van",
+        "lv3": "cong-van-tncn",
+        "reason": "phase26-thue-cong-van-prefix-normalize",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/nhung-diem-moi-cua-thong-tu-96-ve-thue-thu-nhap-doanh-nghiep.html": {
+        "kind": "van-ban",
+        "lv1": "thue",
+        "lv2": "cong-van",
+        "lv3": "cong-van-tndn",
+        "reason": "phase26-thue-cong-van-prefix-normalize",
+    },
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase26_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def expected_lv3_for_ke_toan_form(title: str) -> str | None:
+    t = title.lower()
+    if "phiếu thu" in t or "phiếu chi" in t:
+        return "mau-phieu-thu-phieu-chi"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["báo cáo tài chính", "bảng cân đối kế toán", "thuyết minh báo cáo", "lưu chuyển tiền tệ", "báo cáo kết quả"]):
+        return "mau-bao-cao-tai-chinh"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["khấu hao", "tscđ", "tài sản cố định", "ccdc"]):
+        return "mau-tscd-khau-hao"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["nhập xuất tồn", "phiếu nhập kho", "phiếu xuất kho", "vật tư", "hàng hóa", "kho"]):
+        return "mau-kho-vat-tu-ccdc"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["lương", "bhxh", "bhyt", "bhtn", "nhân sự", "lao động"]):
+        return "mau-luong-nhan-su"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["hợp đồng", "mua bán", "đề nghị thanh toán", "biên bản thanh lý hợp đồng"]):
+        return "mau-chung-tu-mua-ban-hop-dong"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["ủy nhiệm chi", "séc", "giấy báo nợ", "giấy báo có", "thanh toán", "ngoại tệ", "tạm ứng"]):
+        return "mau-chung-tu-tien-thanh-toan"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["thuế", "tờ khai", "đăng ký thuế", "mã số thuế"]):
+        return "mau-thue-ke-khai-dang-ky"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["sổ", "nhật ký", "bảng cân đối tài khoản"]):
+        return "mau-so-sach-ke-toan"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["vốn", "cổ phiếu", "đầu tư"]):
+        return "mau-tai-chinh-von-ngoai-te"
+    return None
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+
+    # 48 bài còn lệch lv3 trong bieu-mau/ke-toan/mau-bieu-ke-toan
+    rows = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "bieu-mau"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "ke-toan"
+        and a.get("topicLv2Key") == "mau-bieu-ke-toan"
+    ]
+    for a in rows:
+        exp = expected_lv3_for_ke_toan_form(a["title"])
+        cur = a.get("topicLv3Key") or ""
+        if exp and exp != cur:
+            decisions[a["href"]] = {
+                "kind": "bieu-mau",
+                "lv1": "ke-toan",
+                "lv2": "mau-bieu-ke-toan",
+                "lv3": exp,
+                "reason": "phase26-ke-toan-form-lv3-normalize",
+            }
+
+    # +2 công văn thuế
+    for href, decision in TOPUP_MOVES.items():
+        decisions[href] = dict(decision)
+
+    if len(decisions) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase26 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện build được {len(decisions)}")
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if (
+            kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS
+            or lv1 not in lv1_labels
+            or lv2 not in lv2_labels
+            or lv3 not in lv3_labels
+        ):
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase26Batch50"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase26-batch50",
+        "plannedCount": len(decisions),
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {"countsAfterRebuild": counts},
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 26 - Batch 50",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Planned: **{len(decisions)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "planned": len(decisions),
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "report": str(OUT_MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: tools/reclassify_phase26_batch50.py
*** Add File: tools/reclassify_phase26_batch50.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 26: batch 50 - chuẩn hóa lv3 cho Biểu mẫu Thuế."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase26-batch50.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase26-batch50.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase26_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def expected_lv3_for_tax_form(title: str) -> str | None:
+    t = title.lower()
+    if any(k in t for k in ["tncn", "thu nhập cá nhân", "khấu trừ thuế tncn"]):
+        return "mau-thue-tncn"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["tndn", "thu nhập doanh nghiệp"]):
+        return "mau-thue-tndn"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["nhà thầu", "nha thau"]):
+        return "mau-thue-nha-thau"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["hộ kinh doanh", "cnkd", "môn bài", "cho thuê nhà", "bđs"]):
+        return "mau-thue-ho-ca-nhan-mon-bai"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["bảng kê", "phụ lục", "khbs", "văn bản đề nghị", "thông báo về việc nộp tiền"]):
+        return "mau-bang-ke-phu-luc-ho-so"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["hóa đơn", "hoá đơn", "gtgt", "mẫu 01/gtgt", "hddt"]):
+        return "mau-thue-gtgt-hoa-don"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["tài nguyên", "bảo vệ môi trường"]):
+        return "mau-bang-ke-phu-luc-ho-so"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["đăng ký thuế", "mst", "đk-tct"]):
+        return "mau-bang-ke-phu-luc-ho-so"
+    return None
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    rows = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "bieu-mau"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "thue"
+        and a.get("topicLv2Key") == "mau-bieu-thue"
+    ]
+    mismatches = []
+    for a in rows:
+        exp = expected_lv3_for_tax_form(a["title"])
+        cur = a.get("topicLv3Key") or ""
+        if exp and exp != cur:
+            mismatches.append((a["href"], exp))
+
+    selected = sorted(mismatches, key=lambda x: x[0])[:50]
+    if len(selected) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase26 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện chọn được {len(selected)}")
+
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for href, lv3 in selected:
+        decisions[href] = {
+            "kind": "bieu-mau",
+            "lv1": "thue",
+            "lv2": "mau-bieu-thue",
+            "lv3": lv3,
+            "reason": "phase26-thue-form-lv3-normalize",
+        }
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if (
+            kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS
+            or lv1 not in lv1_labels
+            or lv2 not in lv2_labels
+            or lv3 not in lv3_labels
+        ):
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase26Batch50"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase26-batch50",
+        "plannedCount": len(decisions),
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {"countsAfterRebuild": counts},
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 26 - Batch 50",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Planned: **{len(decisions)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(

+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase28_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module

+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"

+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+

+def main() -> None:

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 29: batch 50 - chuẩn hóa lv3 cho Văn bản/Thuế (Công văn + Thông tư)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase29-batch50.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase29-batch50.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase29_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def expected_cv_lv3(title: str) -> str:
+    t = title.lower()
+    if any(k in t for k in ["tncn", "thu nhập cá nhân", "người phụ thuộc"]):
+        return "cong-van-tncn"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["tndn", "thu nhập doanh nghiệp"]):
+        return "cong-van-tndn"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["gtgt", "hóa đơn", "hoá đơn", "khấu trừ", "hoàn thuế"]):
+        return "cong-van-gtgt-hoa-don"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["kê khai", "quản lý thuế", "đăng ký thuế", "mst", "mã số thuế", "chấm dứt hiệu lực mã số thuế"]):
+        return "cong-van-ke-khai-quan-ly-thue"
+    return "cong-van-chinh-sach-chung"
+
+
+def expected_tt_lv3(title: str) -> str:
+    t = title.lower()
+    if any(k in t for k in ["tncn", "thu nhập cá nhân"]):
+        return "thong-tu-tncn"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["tndn", "thu nhập doanh nghiệp"]):
+        return "thong-tu-tndn"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["gtgt", "hóa đơn", "hoá đơn"]):
+        return "thong-tu-gtgt-hoa-don"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["hộ kinh doanh", "cá nhân kinh doanh", "cnkd"]):
+        return "thong-tu-ho-ca-nhan-kinh-doanh"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["đăng ký thuế", "mst", "mã số thuế"]):
+        return "thong-tu-mst-dang-ky-thue"
+    if any(k in t for k in ["kê khai", "quản lý thuế"]):
+        return "thong-tu-ke-khai-quan-ly-thue"
+    return "thong-tu-chinh-sach-chung"
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    candidates_cv: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
+    candidates_tt: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
+
+    for a in data_articles:
+        if a.get("section") != "thu-vien":
+            continue
+        if a.get("libraryKindKey") != "van-ban":
+            continue
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key") != "thue":
+            continue
+        lv2 = a.get("topicLv2Key") or ""
+        cur = a.get("topicLv3Key") or ""
+        if lv2 == "cong-van":
+            exp = expected_cv_lv3(a["title"])
+            if exp != cur:
+                candidates_cv.append((a["href"], exp))
+        elif lv2 == "thong-tu":
+            exp = expected_tt_lv3(a["title"])
+            if exp != cur:
+                candidates_tt.append((a["href"], exp))
+
+    candidates_cv.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
+    candidates_tt.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
+
+    selected = list(candidates_cv)
+    needed = 50 - len(selected)
+    if needed > 0:
+        selected.extend(candidates_tt[:needed])
+    selected = selected[:50]
+
+    if len(selected) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase29 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện chọn được {len(selected)}")
+
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for href, lv3 in selected:
+        # giữ nguyên lv2 (cong-van hoặc thong-tu), chỉ chuẩn hóa lv3
+        decisions[href] = {
+            "kind": "van-ban",
+            "lv1": "thue",
+            "lv2": "cong-van" if "/cong-van" in href else "",  # placeholder; sẽ set đúng bên dưới
+            "lv3": lv3,
+            "reason": "phase29-vanban-thue-lv3-normalize",
+        }
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        # giữ lv2 hiện tại để tránh lỗi suy luận
+        lv2 = article.get("topicLv2Key") or ""
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if (
+            kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS
+            or lv1 not in lv1_labels
+            or lv2 not in lv2_labels
+            or lv3 not in lv3_labels
+        ):
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase29Batch50"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase29-batch50",
+        "plannedCount": 50,
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {"countsAfterRebuild": counts},
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 29 - Batch 50",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        "- Planned: **50**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "planned": 50,
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "report": str(OUT_MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
